<!-- wildcat-origin: shoggoth -->

Closes wildcat-finance/skills#508

## Product

This run implements the three residual contracts: native worker confinement and private admission, cumulative exhausted-audit carryover with replacement reconstruction and current guards, and inert runbook command-interface validation with receipt replay. A joined lifecycle fixture exercises them through the controller integration transition. The [contracts and fixtures README](docs/fiat-508-residual/README.md), [carryover reference](plugins/hexaemeron/skills/fiat/references/carryover-packet.md) and [command reference](plugins/hexaemeron/skills/protasis/references/gate-commands.md) describe the supported interfaces. The original study and runbook text is retained; the current runbook includes 21 admitted amendments.

Workers use a native macOS policy, bounded time and captured bytes, and private admitted files from permanently retired scratch. Cumulative packets retain every prior pass, raw occurrence and inherited disposition. Separate replacement admission reconstructs the complete current base before running unchanged restricted guard bodies and requires a fresh independent audit. Historical guard/family unknowns remain unknown; explicit current mappings prove current coverage only. Native signed proof and separately preserved private reconstruction storage remain replay dependencies; the packet contains no Git bundle.

Protasis validates supported literal and finite-loop commands without executing them, binds full CLI and adapter sources, and preserves original report declarations and producer bytes. New-run receipts replay those identities; legacy records keep their earlier contract. Captured absolute report operands remain historical derivations, with current-root resolution checked separately on relocation. `operation_ran:false` grants no execution or test-success authority. Ordinary relative-root verification now retains native identity and symlink checks.

## Verification

The [audit record](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/57b20c3dc09f75b604780a4f30eec3ad5b5716e0/audit/rounds/fiat-508-restudy-residual-carryover-confinement-and-g.md) preserves every round, finding, repair and evidence limit. The final [independent Step 7 audit](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1668) found zero issues, with no fixes or Elenchus verdict; both hosted checks passed. All seven delivery steps merged into the run branch, from [Step 1](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1595) through [Step 7](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1669). Each merge has a controller receipt. The signed composition at `5c278cfc32d7230c4ee63402981a4e4f839fc143` supersedes `7a351e9b7a998e5d74edbc2912d5e0e02c8304f6`, preserves the same product `a6558d2526af96e89b46078acec68ac98ebfd0ea` and main `6982793334003dc0a441d6e90e753a143e3f2a6c` parents and tree, and has the required ADR assignment trailers; its two integration revalidation checks passed.

All 35 checks passed on implementation `b815f5495e6198e04c18e24edbc01107178b6a39` in `.hexaemeron/reports/step-7-checked.json`. Checked Hex passed 2,792 tests without failures, errors or skips; checked root passed 1,919 with one disposable-snapshot skip, and other suites retain their reported skips. Separate normal implementation and audit root gates each passed 1,919 without skips. All eleven conformance criteria passed; six joined specimens ran in one lifecycle test. Ten earlier criteria were freshly recut while twenty historical reports stayed unchanged. The independent audit separately reran the lifecycle test and three discipline lints. These results retain their actual source identities. All 11 checks selected for the later audit and prose changes passed on `8caf87c07a3db82149c656d59f2ff7640f824dd6` in `.hexaemeron/reports/step-7-final-checked.json`, with the same source identity before, after and in the report. Its root suite passed 1,919 tests in 244.279 seconds with one disposable-snapshot skip; the signed prose commit's normal gate passed 1,919 in 256.470 seconds without skips. All 21 conformance dependency blobs and modes remained unchanged. The operator join `.hexaemeron/reports/step-7-final-validation.json` retains the original full 35-check result and these 11 delta checks; it does not relabel the full run as final-head evidence. Integration-composition checks remain pending.

Rerun the complete proof with the recorded Python version and an unused report path:

```bash
python3 scripts/run_checks.py --full --base 45858244335a4d2af11e9c538df3f906ae324239 --jobs 12 --report .hexaemeron/reports/issue-508-review-fresh.json
```

The default-root repair has a preserved same-test old/fixed pair, not a normalized Step 7 Elenchus verdict. Earlier failures remain recorded, including the unexplained Hex SIGTERM and intermittent `source-changed` observation; no cause is invented. Historical model prompts and answers were preserved and retallied, not rerun. Current promise/coverage/history counts are 101 and runtime bindings 49; historical `entry_count` 80 stays unchanged. The final suppression check passed with a degraded repository analyser, 245 candidates and zero suppressions; it proves neither complete analysis nor zero candidates.

## Limits and pending integration

The joined fixture uses actual signed local Git, native guards and controller transitions with controlled attachment and host Git/GitHub transport. Its audit round proves transition handling only; independent Warden review is separate. Missing or changed producer evidence and CLI drift refuse integration; the missing gate receipt proves state/ledger disagreement only. No production model backend, VM deployment or confinement of conversation tools is established.

Global metadata reads and literal `/dev/null` allowances remain. Detached-descendant death, aggregate CPU/resource limits and total scratch quotas are unproved. Namespace checks observe changes without atomic locking. Promotion preserves actual displaced destinations and installs exclusively; refusal can leave a destination absent and require operator restoration. There is no atomic rollback or global disk quota over retired attempts, temporaries and independently grown files.

The 256 MiB active reservation covers two image copies, two original copies and the largest simultaneous candidate temporary. The 64 MiB packet and decoded budgets, 2 MiB native Git call bound, 25 MB provider limit and 25 MiB reader cap remain distinct; conservative reservations can refuse smaller packets. Paths are ASCII-only. The 30-second readback acceptance deadline and socket timeouts are not a hard total return bound through DNS, trickling headers or detached sockets.

Main integration, final issue status and merge remain pending. The controller recorded `fiat-version-resolution/v2` against that exact composition, resolving Fiat to `fiat-v6.61.1` and Protasis to `protasis-v5.12.0`; the cross-evolution recovery is explicitly tied to issue #1666 and the user's delivery authority. The run preserves its original issue 363 anchor; issue 363 has since closed on main, and this run does not claim its delivery. The mature Protasis frontier remains unchanged. This draft does not report a merge or issue closure.

## Carried forward

Existing programme issues retain their broader ownership. The remaining limits below are explicit boundaries or unproved observations of this finite prototype; no new issue was filed merely to complete this record.

```carryover
signed-launch-request | duplicate | https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/872
disposable-vm-launcher | duplicate | https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/873
trusted-fiat-adapter | duplicate | https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/875
hostile-whole-path-pilot | duplicate | https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/878
native-policy-and-resource-limits | none | Global metadata and literal /dev/null allowances, detached-descendant death, aggregate resource limits and total scratch quotas remain documented prototype limits; no broader enforcement is claimed.
external-custody-and-partial-promotion | none | Native proof and private storage remain required; interrupted promotion may need operator restoration. This retained recovery contract claims neither atomic rollback nor a total-history quota.
packet-and-readback-bounds | none | ASCII-only paths, distinct size caps and the non-hard total readback deadline are explicit supported-interface limits, not promises of broader acceptance.
controlled-host-and-fixture-audit | none | Controlled attachment and host transport, fixture audit transitions and the gate state/ledger specimen prove only their stated fixture scope; broader programme work keeps its existing owners above.
unexplained-historical-failures | none | The earlier Hex SIGTERM and intermittent source-changed causes remain unknown with original evidence preserved; the run supplies no causal finding to file.
incomplete-dead-code-analysis | none | The repository analyser remains degraded with 245 candidates and zero suppressions; a passing suppression gate is not a complete analysis or evidence that every candidate is a defect.
historical-model-and-guard-evidence | none | Historical model observations and missing guard identities remain historical or unknown; current retally and guard execution do not create past evidence.
```
